_: Subsumed (Helminth) versions of warframe abilities: how they differ from the original. Numbers and wording from the wiki infobox `helminth` field (scripts/fetch-wiki-abilities.mjs); `wiki` is that text as of the last check: build-frames.mjs warns when the wiki changes it. set: {"str.0": value} replaces a stat (field.index as in data/wiki-abilities.json), drop: stats that do not apply, add: extra stats, cost: energy, note: shown with the ability.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Abilities/Sen.title: Sentient Wrath
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Abilities/Sen.wiki: However, subsumed Sentient Wrath only strikes in a frontal cone and does not inflict Tau status effects.

note.ru: Привитая: бьёт только конусом перед собой и не накладывает статус Тау.
note.en: Subsumed: strikes only in a frontal cone, no Tau status.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Abilities/GeodeS.title: Fractured Blast
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Abilities/GeodeS.wiki: However, Subsumed Fractured Blast's damage is reduced to 125 / 150 / 200 / 250, Health Orb drop chance reduced to 25%, and Energy Orb drop chance reduced to 10%.

note.ru: Привитая: урон и шансы сфер здоровья/энергии вдвое ниже.
note.en: Subsumed: half the damage and orb drop chances.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Abilities.title: Evade
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Abilities.wiki: However, Subsumed Evade's maximum duration is reduced to 15 seconds and is capped at 25 seconds. Currently this helminth is bugged and the maximum duration is not capped at 25 seconds.

note.ru: Привитая: невидимость короче, предел — 25 с (по вики сейчас предел не работает из-за бага).
note.en: Subsumed: shorter invisibility capped at 25 s (bugged in game: the cap doesn't apply).

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Abilities/Dagat.title: Wyrd Scythes
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Abilities/Dagat.wiki: However, Subsumed Wyrd Scythe's slow is reduced to 15 / 18 / 22 / 26%. Slow is capped to 71% achievable with 272% Ability Strength.

note.ru: Привитая: замедление слабее, предел 71% (при 272% силы).
note.en: Subsumed: weaker slow, capped at 71% (272% Strength).

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/FireBl.title: Fire Blast
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/FireBl.wiki: Armor reduction per cast is capped at 75%, achievable with 100% Ability Strength. Healing Flame will not generate Overguard on other Warframes.

note.ru: Привитая: снижение брони за применение не выше 75% (при 100% силы); «Целебное пламя» не даёт сверхщит союзникам.
note.en: Subsumed: armor reduction per cast capped at 75% (100% Strength); Healing Flame gives no Overguard to others.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkC.title: Self Portrait
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkC.wiki: However, Subsumed Self Portrait's maximum Damage Reduction caps at 75% and does not apply Inkblot.

note.ru: Привитая: снижение урона не выше 75%, без Кляксы.
note.en: Subsumed: damage reduction capped at 75%, no Inkblot.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Abilities/Runne.title: Thermal Sunder
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Abilities/Runne.wiki: The damage dealt by Subsumed Thermal Sunder is equivalent to 50% of Gauss's battery: 225 / 300 / 375 / 450 Cold damage and 450 / 600 / 750 / 900 Heat damage. However, the damage scaling from Heat status is capped to 10x of the ability's damage.

note.ru: Привитая: урон как от половины батареи Гаусса — 450 Холода и 900 Огня; рост урона от статуса Огня — не больше 10×.
note.en: Subsumed: damage as from half of Gauss's battery — 450 Cold and 900 Heat; Heat status scaling capped at 10×.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Abilities/Dev.title: Nourish
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Abilities/Dev.wiki: Other Warframes are omitted from the swallowed enemy requirement, due to their inability to cast Feast. However, Subsumed Nourish does not provide healing, the explosion only applies 1 Viral stack, the energy multiplier is reduced to 1.3 / 1.39 / 1.48 / 1.6x, and Viral weapon bonus damage is reduced to +24% / +30% / +36% / +45%. Subsumed energy bonus is calculated with the following formula: Ability Strength)}}

note.ru: Привитая: не лечит, взрыв даёт 1 заряд Вируса, множитель энергии 1,6×, бонус Вирусного урона оружию +45%.
note.en: Subsumed: no healing, the explosion applies 1 Viral stack, energy multiplier 1.6×, Viral weapon bonus +45%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/Abilities/Ir.title: Pillage
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/Abilities/Ir.wiki: Subsumed Pillage uses 50 energy instead of shields. Does not generate shields for Inaros, Nidus, or Kullervo.

note.ru: Привитая: стоит 50 энергии вместо щитов; Инаросу, Нидусу и Куллерво щиты не даёт.
note.en: Subsumed: costs 50 energy instead of shields; gives no shields to Inaros, Nidus or Kullervo.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Abilities/ChoirE.title: Ophanim Eyes
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Abilities/ChoirE.wiki: However, Subsumed Ophanim Eyes will not have the ability to revive allies from Bleedout.

note.ru: Привитая: не поднимает союзников из Обескровливания.
note.en: Subsumed: can't revive allies from Bleedout.

/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/Abilities.title: Wrathful Advance
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/Abilities.wiki: However, Subsumed Wrathful Advance's range is reduced to 10 / 11 / 11.5 / 12.5 meters and melee critical chance bonus reduced to 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% (only the targeting, the hold to teleport range is unchanged) The bonus critical chance also applies to Exalted Weapons, including formerly pseudo-exalted abilities such as Landslide, Slash Dash, Shattered Lash and Whipclaw.

note.ru: Привитая: дальность выбора цели 12,5 м (телепорт по удержанию — как был), бонус к шансу крита ближнего боя 100%; действует и на экзальтед-оружие.
note.en: Subsumed: 12.5 m targeting range (hold-to-teleport unchanged), +100% melee crit chance; applies to Exalted weapons too.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Abilities/Al.title: Vial Rush
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Abilities/Al.wiki: Subsumed Vial Rush includes the 0 energy cost, 5 second cooldown, as well as 3 Cold status proc stacks per application from the explosion and residue pools. Subsumed Vial Rush does not include the hold-cast to imbue the next ability cast with Cold damage.

note.ru: Привитая: без затрат энергии, перезарядка 5 с; без зарядки следующей способности Холодом (удержание).
note.en: Subsumed: no energy cost, 5 s cooldown; no hold-cast Cold imbue.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/PullAbil.title: Pull
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/PullAbil.wiki: However, Subsumed Pull's pull range is reduced to 7.5 / 10 / 11 / 12.5 meters.

note.ru: Привитая: дальность притяжения 12,5 м.
note.en: Subsumed: 12.5 m pull range.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Li.title: Eclipse
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Li.wiki: However, Subsumed Eclipse's damage reduction caps at 75% and damage bonus is reduced to 2% / 9% / 15% / 30%.

note.ru: Привитая: бонус урона 30%, снижение урона не выше 75%.
note.en: Subsumed: 30% damage bonus, damage reduction capped at 75%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Abilities/.title: Larva
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Abilities/.wiki: However, Subsumed Larva's range is reduced to 5.33 / 6 / 6.67 / 8 meters. When Larva is injected onto a Prime Warframe, it will gain the appearance of Nidus Prime's Larva.

note.ru: Привитая: радиус захвата 8 м.
note.en: Subsumed: 8 m grab radius.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoP.title: Brightbonnet
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoP.wiki: The Ability Strength bonus is diminished to 10% / 13% / 17% / 20% and energy restore is reduced to 6.67 / 8 / 8.67 / 10. The Ability Strength bonus cap is diminished to 100%, which is still doubled if Invigorated by .

note.ru: Привитая: бонус силы 20% (предел 100%, вдвое выше с усилением Арбуцепа), энергия 10.
note.en: Subsumed: 20% Strength bonus (cap 100%, doubled by the Arbucep Invigoration), 10 energy.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Smit.title: Smite
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Smit.wiki: However, Subsumed Smite's percentage damage cap is reduced to 50% and the AoE percentage damage cap is reduced to 20%, achievable with 143% and 200% Ability Strength respectively.

note.ru: Привитая: предел процентного урона 50% (при 143% силы), по площади — 20% (при 200%).
note.en: Subsumed: percentage damage cap 50% (143% Strength), AoE cap 20% (200%).

/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/RhinoR.title: Roar
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/RhinoR.wiki: However, Subsumed Roar's damage bonus is reduced to 2% / 9% / 15% / 30%. For example, With 253% Can only get 75.9% bonus

note.ru: Привитый: бонус урона 30% вместо 50%.
note.en: Subsumed: 30% damage bonus instead of 50%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Abilities/Wrait.title: Gloom
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Abilities/Wrait.wiki: When infused into Lavos, Gloom is altered to cost 0 energy to cast and sustain, lasts for 12 seconds that triggers a 10 second cooldown after deactivation.

note.ru: На Лавосе: без затрат энергии, 12 с, затем перезарядка 10 с.
note.en: On Lavos: no energy cost, lasts 12 s, then a 10 s cooldown.

/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/Abilities/D.title: Remedium
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/Abilities/D.wiki: However, Subsumed Remedium's healing is reduced to 24% / 28% / 31% / 35% and does not summon Uriel's Demons.

note.ru: Привитое: лечение 35%, без демонов Уриэля.
note.en: Subsumed: 35% healing, no Uriel's demons.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/Be.title: Warcry
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/Be.wiki: However, Subsumed Warcry's attack speed bonus is reduced to 9% / 12% / 15% / 30%.

note.ru: Привитый: бонус скорости атаки 30% вместо 50%.
note.en: Subsumed: 30% attack speed instead of 50%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/Abilities/M.title: Defy
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/Abilities/M.wiki: However, Subsumed Defy's armor bonus is capped at 750.

note.ru: Привитый: бонус брони не выше 750.
note.en: Subsumed: armor bonus capped at 750.
